visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses and short black hair, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centrally against a night city skyline backdrop featuring Taipei 101. He gestures with both hands, using a small handheld remote as he addresses the camera directly with a neutral but engaged facial expression. (2) A Facebook post overlay appears on the right side of the frame, showing a microscopic image of white, elongated microorganisms. The host continues to speak and gesture, pointing toward the digital evidence while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (3) The scene transitions to show high-resolution scanning electron microscope (SEM) images of circular, spiky eggs labeled 'A' and 'B'. The host is partially obscured or smaller in the frame as he highlights specific morphological features of these microscopic structures with his pointer. (4) A scientific table titled 'Table 1' appears, detailing DNA sequence primers like 18S-RNA and COI. The host gestures towards the technical data, explaining the significance of these genetic markers while the background remains the illuminated city skyline. (5) An evolutionary tree diagram is briefly shown, illustrating the genetic relationships between different species. The host uses his hands to explain the grouping and distinctness of the new species within the taxonomic framework. (6) The host returns to a full medium shot against the city skyline, concluding his presentation. He smiles slightly and gestures towards the camera, wrapping up the narrative about the discovery of the new water bear species in Taiwan.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 臉書上發現台灣新物種!. [Subtitle]: 接下來的畫面可能很可愛. (2) [Subtitle]: 也可能很傷害, 請自行判斷再看下去. (3) [Subtitle]: 好, 這個呢是一種剛被發現, 且以台灣命名的全新物種. (4) [Subtitle]: 台灣趾生水熊. (5) [Subtitle]: 發現新種微生物不稀奇吧. (6) [Subtitle]: 但這隻水熊卻是在Facebook上被發現的. (7) [Subtitle]: 蛤? 不是Facebook有Bug. (8) [Subtitle]: 是有位白植友先生, 他在臉書的. (9) [Subtitle]: 台灣淡水微生物俱樂部社團. (10) [Subtitle]: 分享自己培養的一大群淡水水熊蟲. (11) [Subtitle]: 欸, 是的, 他的寵物是水熊. (12) [Subtitle]: 沒想到這篇文被義大利的科學家滑到. (13) [Subtitle]: 仔細一看, 眉頭一皺, 發現事情不單純. (14) [Subtitle]: 立刻傳訊息說, 欸, 不對喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 你這個水熊蟲的蛋蛋長得不太一樣喔. (16) [Subtitle]: 一場橫跨台灣、義大利、丹麥、波蘭的. (17) [Subtitle]: 跨國任務就此展開. (18) [Subtitle]: 團隊鎖定了新莊頭前運動公園. (19) [Subtitle]: 蓮花池的樣本, 展開嚴格的身家調查. (20) [Subtitle]: 一般顯微鏡不夠看, 於是他們出動. (21) [Subtitle]: 掃描式電子顯微鏡來檢查形態. (22) [Subtitle]: 發現雖然成蟲跟近親很像. (23) [Subtitle]: 但新莊水熊的蛋, 欸就是這個佈滿尖刺. (24) [Subtitle]: 凸起的惡魔果實, 非常不一樣. (25) [Subtitle]: 至於是哪裡不一樣, 你再看細一點. (26) [Subtitle]: 有沒有發現在每一個突起的根部. (27) [Subtitle]: 有一圈獨特的神秘小孔, 欸就是這裡. (28) [Subtitle]: 科學家把所有形態數據丟給電腦跑分析. (29) [Subtitle]: 發現無法否認的差異就在蛋蛋. (30) [Subtitle]: 另一邊基因偵探團也同步開工. (31) [Subtitle]: 科學家分析了18S, 28S, ITS-2跟COI. (32) [Subtitle]: 這四個基因標記. (33) [Subtitle]: 欸為什麼是他們呢? 因為他們的. (34) [Subtitle]: 演化速度不一樣, 各有專精. (35) [Subtitle]: 首先18S跟28S變化超慢. (36) [Subtitle]: 就像查族譜, 用來確認這傢伙. (37) [Subtitle]: 是不是真的Dactylobiotus D的一族. (38) [Subtitle]: COI呢像個人身分證, 是粒線體裡的DNA. (39) [Subtitle]: 在不同物種間有足夠差異. (40) [Subtitle]: 但在同一個物種內相對穩定, 專門區分不同物種. (41) [Subtitle]: 還有變化最快的ITS-2, 它很善變. (42) [Subtitle]: 因此適合用來挖出近親之間最細微的差別. (43) [Subtitle]: 演化樹圖也顯示這群新莊水熊的基因序列. (44) [Subtitle]: 就是自成一群, 跟所有的近親都有明顯區別. (45) [Subtitle]: 所以這個從臉書上發現的新物種. (46) [Subtitle]: 就被正式命名為台灣趾生水熊. (47) [Subtitle]: 煞氣十足, 還登上了. (48) [Subtitle]: 中研院發行的國際期刊Zoological Studies. (49) [Subtitle]: 所以說下次到新莊, 除了到球場用大砲拍三本柱之外. (50) [Subtitle]: 也可以到公園的蓮花池用顯微鏡看看水熊. (51) [Subtitle]: 蛤? 你說你不知道三本柱. (52) [Subtitle]: 你只對水熊有興趣? 恩, 我也是.
